field_semantics: All keys in matrix_fields are represented for each row: known values are in fields; all omitted keys are null/unknown, never inferred.
search_routes: Queries by exact title/DOI and citation-following for SAE, HCCI/ATAC, SI cyclic-variation and 115 cc DI studies.
Searches over Zenodo, Figshare, Mendeley Data, OSF, Dryad, IEEE DataPort (search endpoint robots-blocked), institutional repositories, theses and supplementary-file terms.
Expanded engine families: racing motorcycle, kart, marine, small utility, SI/DISI/HCCI, research single-cylinder and opposed-piston (secondary incompatible control).
Inspected attachments/appendix leads when linked; did not download source papers as if they were datasets or digitize figures.
